item.title: Microsoft posts strong AI-led growth as heavy capex continues
item.description: In Q2, Microsoft’s revenue increased 17% year-on-year to $81.3 billion, while its net profit in the quarter surged to $38.5 billion, up 60% from the year-ago period.

item.title: Labour codes implementation to play key role in supporting formal employment: Economic Survey
item.description: The Economic Survey suggested that as definitions of work continue to evolve, dynamic labour policy and flexible regulatory frameworks would ensure employment expansion, worker security, and well-being.

item.title: India has seen a 3X increase in number of GenAI startups in 2025: Economic Survey
item.description: The Economic Survey noted that cumulative funding for GenAI startups rose to $990 million in H1 CY2025 compared to $758 million in the year-ago period, emerging as a spotlight sector within the country’s deeptech ecosystem.

item.title: India’s gig workers finally have a welfare board, but only Karnataka is walking the talk
item.description: The state’s new framework mandates compulsory worker and platform registration, platform data disclosure, and 1–1.5% welfare levies on each payout—a regulatory shift that could fundamentally reshape how gig work is governed.
